string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: 导航打断音乐DUCK场景演示

string.name: reason_background
string.value: 音频播放需要后台运行

string.name: index_description
string.value: 导航打断音乐 — 音频焦点DUCK场景开发实战

string.name: scheme_one_desc
string.value: 导航播报自动DUCK音乐音量，无需额外适配

string.name: scheme_two_desc
string.value: 导航声明DUCK策略，结束后deactivate恢复音乐音量

string.name: scheme_three_desc
string.value: 音乐声明混音模式，导航播报不再压低音乐音量

string.name: duck_page_desc
string.value: 导航播报自动DUCK音乐音量，结束后自动恢复

string.name: duck_step_1
string.value: 1. 先点击"播放音乐"启动音乐

string.name: duck_step_2
string.value: 2. 再点击"开始导航"启动导航播报

string.name: duck_step_3
string.value: 3. 观察音乐是否收到DUCK(音量降低)

string.name: duck_step_4
string.value: 4. 点击"结束导航"，观察音乐是否收到UNDUCK(音量恢复)

string.name: duck_session_page_desc
string.value: 导航声明DUCK策略（修改模式），结束后deactivate→UNDUCK

string.name: session_active_modify_mode
string.value: AudioSession已激活（修改模式）：AudioSession不持有焦点

string.name: navigating_duck_session_active
string.value: 导航播报中(AudioSession DUCK_OTHERS已激活)

string.name: duck_session_step_4
string.value: 4. 结束导航 → stopRenderer + deactivateAudioSession → 音乐UNDUCK

string.name: duck_session_step_5
string.value: 5. 导航自然结束 → stopRenderer + deactivateAudioSession → 音乐UNDUCK

string.name: mix_session_page_desc
string.value: 音乐声明混音模式，导航播报不再压低音乐音量

string.name: mix_mode_enabled_desc
string.value: 已开启：导航播报不会降低音乐音量，两者同时播放

string.name: mix_mode_disabled_desc
string.value: 已关闭：导航播报将降低音乐音量(默认DUCK行为)

string.name: mix_step_1
string.value: 1. 关闭混音开关 → 播放音乐 → 开始导航 → 观察DUCK

string.name: mix_step_2
string.value: 2. 开启混音开关 → 播放音乐 → 开始导航 → 观察不DUCK

string.name: mix_step_3
string.value: 3. 混音模式下来电仍会触发PAUSE(高优先级不受MIX影响)
